Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. POSTURE: standing at a waist-high railing or sill.

RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on the railing — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small antique pocket watch whose hands and hour marks glow faintly in the dark at chest height; it is all she holds.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: softened eyes, faint sad smile, inner brows raised.
